snippet.title: VELASTER GAME PLAY TRAILER
snippet.description:
VELASTER is a 3D side-scrolling action game, and we’re excited to announce that it is now available in Early Access on Steam starting December 10.

We’d be incredibly grateful for your interest and support.
Feel free to join our Discord or follow us on our social channels to share your thoughts and feedback — it truly helps us shape the future of the game.

Thank you so much!

SteamPage : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897060/VELASTER/ 

Discord : https://discord.gg/38vWUd9fES
